summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing its intent to file a resale registration statement for its 7.50% Senior Unsecured Convertible Notes, Series B due 2031, and the underlying ordinary shares. The Notes, issued on July 17, 2026, have an aggregate principal amount of $125 million. The filing relates to the company's registration rights agreement, notifying holders of the draft registration statement to be emailed on or about August 3, 2026, and requesting completed Selling Securityholder Questionnaires. This is a routine administrative step in connection with the convertible note issuance, not a special situation.
